description: This source file defines extension methods for the XGraphics class in PDFsharp, adding support for PDF/UA (Accessible PDF) features such as drawing strings, images, links, and list items with accessibility tags and structure annotations.

classes.name: XGraphicsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the XGraphics class to support PDF/UA annotations and accessibility-enhanced drawing operations.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Extension methods to draw strings with PDF/UA structure elements, supporting block and inline level tagging.

methods.name: DrawAbbreviation
methods.description: Draws an abbreviation with a PDF Inline Level Element tag, including the expanded text as accessibility information.

methods.name: DrawImage
methods.description: Draws images with associated accessibility tags and optional alternative text.

methods.name: DrawLink
methods.description: Draws hyperlinks with accessibility annotations and optional alternative text.

methods.name: DrawListItem
methods.description: Draws list items with appropriate structure tags for accessibility.
